# Cowy

> AI accuracy for baby & kids brands. Cowy makes sure that when AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) talk about your baby or kids brand, they get the facts right — finding every wrong, outdated, or misattributed answer, fixing the sources behind it, and proving the correction.

Cowy is a done-for-you service built only for baby & kids consumable DTC brands on Shopify: formula, baby food & pouches, diapers, wipes, skincare & bath, and kids vitamins. The job is accuracy, not visibility — making sure AI never misstates your ingredients, age ranges, certifications, or claims.

## What Cowy does
- Checks what AI assistants say about your products and flags every wrong, outdated, or misattributed fact.
- Traces each error to the source AI reads, then fixes the sources you control and out-publishes the ones you don't.
- Monitors AI answers over time and alerts you the moment a wrong fact appears.

## Method
Find → Trace → Fix → Prove: find the wrong answers, trace them to their sources, fix the sources, and prove the correction with a before/after.

## Offers
- Free check: a 30-second look at what AI gets wrong about you, with a score and your top gaps.
- AI Accuracy Report ($1,500 one-time): complete audit plus first fixes, credited if you go monthly within 7 days.
- AI Watchdog ($79/mo): ongoing monitoring and alerts when AI states a wrong fact about your products.
- Done-For-You ($2,500/mo): monthly fixes that keep AI accurate about your brand, with proof.
